questions.target: 社会信息 / 推断边界
questions.q: A shop’s guide calls replacing a worn battery “settling for yesterday’s technology.” It says nothing about whether a repaired phone would meet its owner’s needs. Which inference is best supported?
o: The guide judges repairs from owners’ reported dissatisfaction.
The guide compares replacements by how long they last.
The guide frames repair negatively without establishing that it fails to meet users’ needs.
The guide identifies a technical obstacle that prevents battery replacement.

exp.trans: 一家商店的指南把更换磨损的电池称为“将就使用过时技术”。它没有讨论修好的手机能否满足机主的需要。最有依据的推断是：它对维修附加了负面评价，却没有证明维修无法满足需要。
exp.structure: 主句A shop’s guide + calls + replacing a worn battery + 引语，call把维修描述成某种选择。It指guide；whether从句是about的补足内容，a repaired phone是该从句主语，would meet是谓语。
exp.other: worn 磨损的；settle for 将就接受；battery 电池；meet someone’s needs 满足某人的需要。
exp.meaning: 区分价值标签与功能证据。“过时”是指南附加的评价标签，不能直接升级为对实际需要是否得到满足的证据，也不必出现人身侮辱才有否定性信息。
exp.rest: reported dissatisfaction补出未报告的用户调查；how long they last偷换成使用寿命比较；technical obstacle把负面描述变成无法换电池的技术原因，三者都没有文本依据。

questions.target: 资金目标 / 报告义务条件
questions.skill: 目的与条件的跨语境迁移
questions.q: A university wanted funding for a water-quality pilot. The grant agency agreed to provide the money only if the university submitted quarterly progress reports. What was the university seeking when it accepted that requirement?
o: Employment as a reporting contractor.
An exemption from future water testing.
Funding for its water-quality project.
The right to approve other universities' grants.

exp.trans: 大学想为水质试点项目争取资金；资助机构同意拨款，但要求大学按季度提交进度报告。大学接受报告义务是为了得到项目资金。
exp.structure: The university + wanted + funding；only if引出拨款所附带的条件。submitted quarterly reports是条件，不是大学原本要获得的主要利益。
exp.other: grant 资助款；pilot 试点；quarterly 每季度的；exemption 豁免。
exp.meaning: 先找wanted/目的，再找only if/条件。不要因为条件句离题干更近，就把“提交报告”当成申请的最终目标。
exp.rest: 承包商雇佣没有出现；豁免测试与试点目的相反；批准其他大学经费的权力也没有证据。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.q: The damaged page could conceivably contain the date we need, but the faded ink cannot yet be read. Which claim keeps the writer’s certainty level?
o: 页面上已经确认写有需要的日期。
需要的日期很可能就在这一页，比其他页更有可能。
这页或许写有需要的日期，目前仍未证实。
这页故意省略了日期。

exp.trans: 那张受损的页面或许写有我们需要的日期，但褪色的墨迹目前还无法辨认。准确改写保留可能性，并说明尚未证实。
exp.structure: The damaged page是主语，could contain是谓语，the date是宾语；we need是省略关系代词的定语从句。conceivably修饰可能性；but之后the faded ink + cannot yet be read是被动谓语。
exp.other: damaged 受损的；faded 褪色的；ink 墨迹；certainty 确定程度。
exp.meaning: conceivably表示可以设想有这种可能。它既不是已经确认，也不自动表示比其他方案更可能。
exp.rest: “已经确认”抹掉could与无法辨认的限制；“很可能、比其他页更可能”加入原文没有的概率比较；“故意省略”把可能存在日期误写成有意不写，既换内容又补动机。

questions.target: 题干对象 / 评价对象匹配
questions.skill: 关键词相似前先核对主语
questions.q: A review says: “The report contains pages of anecdotes and too little analysis of why small firms avoid the subsidy.” It later adds: “The subsidy’s most serious weakness is that participation falls once temporary bonuses end.” If asked what the report fails to do, which answer is best?
o: explain adequately why small firms avoid the subsidy
produce participation that lasts after bonuses end
remove all anecdotes from the discussion
prove that temporary bonuses never increase participation

exp.trans: 评论先说报告轶事过多，却没有充分分析小企业为何避开补贴；后面又说补贴本身最严重的问题是奖金结束后参与度下降。若题干问“报告没做到什么”，答案应回到报告本身。
exp.structure: 第一句The report是被评价对象；第二句The subsidy’s most serious weakness把评价对象切换成补贴政策。题干再次锁定the report。
exp.other: anecdote 轶事；subsidy 补贴；participation 参与度；temporary bonus 临时奖励。
exp.meaning: 看到most serious weakness之类强信号不能直接选，先检查这个weakness属于谁。正确选项可以只改写并列句中的一侧，不必覆盖整句所有批评。
exp.rest: “produce participation that lasts...”描述的是subsidy的持久效果，不是report的写作缺陷；“remove all anecdotes”把too many夸大成必须全部删除；“prove...never”加入绝对化的never和原文没有的证明要求。

questions.q: “Residents have a point: the evening bus reaches the station after the last train has left.” What does have a point convey?
o: 居民的意见有道理，时刻表提供了理由。
居民已经同意公交运营方的安排。
公交晚到导致火车晚点。
居民指出了一个新的候车地点。

exp.trans: “居民说得有道理：晚班公交抵达车站时，末班火车已经离开了。”问题问have a point表达什么。
exp.structure: Residents是主语，have是谓语，a point是宾语。冒号后的the evening bus + reaches + the station给出理由；after从句的has left表示火车先已离开。
exp.other: resident 居民；station 车站；the last train 末班火车；timetable 时刻表。
exp.meaning: have a point表示某人的意见有道理或值得考虑。这里肯定的是意见所据的理由，不是找到一个地点；与miss the point不同，这次是抓到了有效理由。
exp.rest: “同意运营方”加入了原文没有的立场，且解释的是时刻衔接不便。“导致火车晚点”倒置了时间信息：火车已走，并未晚点。“新的候车地点”把抽象的意见或道理误当具体地点。

questions.target: be subject to / be subjected to
questions.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
questions.q: 需要写一句仍适用的票务规则：“发车时间可能调整。”这里只说明可能性，不报告已经执行的处理。哪句准确？
o: Departure times were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday.
Departure times are subject to change.
Departure times are subjected to a detailed inspection every morning.
Departure times are immune to change.

exp.trans: Departure times are subject to change：发车时间可能发生调整。
exp.structure: Departure times（主语）+ are（系动词）+ subject to change（表语）。这里是规则或可能状态，不是在叙述谁已经对时刻表做了什么处理。
exp.other: departure 出发；adjustment 调整；inspection 检查；be immune to 不受……影响。
exp.meaning: be subject to在这条规则中表示可能受变化影响。be subjected to通常强调某对象被施加了某个过程。
exp.rest: were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday：报告昨天实际经历了反复调整，时态和事件性质均不符。are subjected to a detailed inspection：说每天被施加检查过程，inspection也不是时间可能调整。are immune to change：表示不受变化影响，与题意相反。

questions.skill: 固定表达 / 借鉴经验
questions.q: The museum hopes to take a page from game designers by giving visitors small goals as they move through the exhibition. Which paraphrase is best?
o: The museum plans to learn from game designers' methods.
The museum wants game designers to replace its curators.
The museum will copy a page from a design manual word for word.
The museum intends to turn the exhibition into a commercial video game.

exp.trans: 博物馆希望借鉴游戏设计师的方法，让参观者在展览过程中完成一些小目标。
exp.structure: The museum是主语，hopes是谓语，to take a page from game designers是不定式内容；by giving...说明具体借鉴的做法。
exp.other: curator 馆员；exhibition 展览；goal 目标；method 方法。
exp.meaning: take a page from是比喻表达，核心是“从……的经验/做法中学习”。后面的by短语通常会说明具体学了什么。
exp.rest: replace curators把借鉴偷换成替换人员；copy a page按字面理解；commercial video game把局部方法扩成整个产品形态。

social-message-inference.target: 社会评价 / 信息影响
social-message-inference.q: A workplace culture repeatedly celebrates employees who stay late, and workers who leave on time are often reminded that “real commitment means sacrifice.” What is most safely suggested?
o: Workers who leave on time are formally punished every day.
The culture may make some workers question whether they are committed enough.
Employees who stay late are always more productive.
Managers ignore workers who leave on time.

exp.trans: 一种职场文化反复赞美加班员工，而准时下班的人经常被提醒“真正的投入意味着牺牲”。最稳妥的推断是：这种文化可能让一些人怀疑自己是否足够投入。
exp.structure: 主句1：A workplace culture + celebrates + employees。who stay late修饰employees。主句2：workers who leave on time + are reminded + that从句。that从句给出被灌输的信息。题目要从这种持续信息推断心理影响，而不是擅自添加处罚事实。
exp.other: workplace culture 职场文化；commitment 投入/忠诚；sacrifice 牺牲；question whether 怀疑是否。
exp.meaning: 持续传递带否定意味的价值标准可以构成广义批评，不必出现直接人身侮辱。本题的具体线索支持自我评价可能受到影响，但不支持正式惩罚或跨群体满意度比较。
exp.rest: formally punished every day加入原文没有的正式处罚；always more productive把价值宣传偷换成生产率事实；ignore与“are often reminded”相反。

social-message-inference.target: 社会评价 / 信息影响
social-message-inference.q: At a school, the wall of honour lists only perfect test scores. A pupil who has improved greatly still asks, “Does my progress count if I never appear on that wall?” Which inference is best supported?
o: The pupil has been personally insulted by every teacher.
The display may lead the pupil to doubt the value of improvement without perfection.
The school has failed to display any test scores.
Every pupil with a perfect score has made greater progress.

exp.trans: 一所学校的荣誉墙只列满分成绩。一名进步很大的学生仍问：“如果我从未登上那面墙，我的进步还算数吗？”最稳妥的推断是：这种展示可能让他怀疑没有满分的进步是否有价值。
exp.structure: 第一句：the wall of honour + lists + only perfect test scores。第二句：A pupil + asks + 引语；who has improved greatly修饰pupil。引语里if从句给出没有上榜这一条件。学生的问题体现了对进步价值的怀疑。
exp.other: wall of honour 荣誉墙；perfect score 满分；progress 进步；count 有价值/算数。
exp.meaning: 持续传递带否定意味的价值标准可以构成广义批评，不必出现直接人身侮辱。本题的具体线索支持自我评价可能受到影响，但不支持正式惩罚或跨群体满意度比较。
exp.rest: personally insulted无直接侮辱证据，every teacher还扩大范围；failed to display any scores与列出满分矛盾；greater progress把最终成绩偷换成进步幅度。

social-message-inference.target: 反复信息 / 评价与比较
social-message-inference.q: The town newsletter repeatedly portrays residents who do not volunteer as “taking from the town without giving back.” Non-volunteers hear this judgment week after week. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: Every resident wants the newsletter to close.
Non-volunteers are repeatedly exposed to disapproving social judgments.
The newsletter never mentions non-volunteers.
Non-volunteers are generally less happy than volunteers.

exp.trans: 镇上的简报反复把不做志愿服务的居民描述成“只索取而不回馈”。他们周复一周听到这种评价。可以确认：他们持续接收到带否定意味的社会评价。
exp.structure: The town newsletter + portrays + residents + as引语。who do not volunteer修饰residents；第二句Non-volunteers + hear + this judgment，this judgment回指前文负面描述，week after week强调反复。
exp.other: newsletter 简报；volunteer 做志愿服务；give back 回馈；disapproving 不赞同的；judgment 评价。
exp.meaning: 带否定意味的评价即使没有直接辱骂，也可以构成criticism。题文直接支持这种评价持续存在，不提供两个群体幸福水平的比较。
exp.rest: Every resident扩大到全部居民并猜测态度；never mentions与反复描述无志愿服务者矛盾；generally less happy把受评价的处境扩大成群体幸福比较，没有比较数据或明确陈述。

transaction-purpose.target: 买方目标 / 批准交易 / 附加条件
transaction-purpose.q: A local museum agreed to maintain public access for ten years as a condition of city approval for its purchase of an old railway station. Why did the museum accept this condition?
o: To obtain permission to acquire the station.
To guarantee that the city would operate the museum for ten years.
To persuade a federal agency to buy the station.
To extend a business license it had already been granted.

exp.trans: 当地博物馆为了获得市政府对购买旧车站的批准，接受了十年内维持公众开放的条件。接受条件的直接目的，是取得购买车站的许可。
exp.structure: A local museum + agreed + to maintain...；as a condition of city approval说明维护开放是获得批准时接受的条件；for its purchase说明交易为博物馆购买车站。
exp.other: acquire 收购、取得；public access 公众进入；maintain 维持；approval 批准。
exp.meaning: 分析交易要分清谁是买方、谁批准，以及目的和附加义务。purchase/acquire是获得资产；维持公众开放是为实现购买而接受的条件。
exp.rest: 市政府运营十年不是承诺内容；federal agency既不是批准方也不是买方；延长已有营业执照与购买旧车站不是同一事项。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

conceivably.q: If the wind weakens before noon, the ferry could conceivably resume service this afternoon, but the operator has made no promise. Conceivably most nearly means:
o: 必然地
有这种可能，但不能确定
故意地
表面上地

exp.trans: 如果中午前风势减弱，渡轮今天下午有可能恢复运营，但运营方没有作出任何保证。
exp.structure: if从句给出条件：the wind weakens before noon。主句：the ferry + could resume + service；conceivably修饰could resume，降低确定性。but后面的no promise进一步说明并不确定。
exp.other: weaken 减弱；ferry 渡轮；resume service 恢复运营；operator 运营方。
exp.meaning: conceivably = 可以设想地、有可能地，强调可能存在但远未确定。
exp.rest: 必然地接近certainly/inevitably，语气过强；故意地是deliberately/intentionally；表面上地是apparently/superficially，均不符合could...but no promise的弱可能语境。

conceivably.q: No existing model explains the readings. They could conceivably point to a new process, although a faulty instrument remains another explanation. Which interpretation is justified?
o: A new process is a possible explanation, alongside an instrument fault.
The readings establish a new process and rule out an instrument fault.
The instrument fault has been confirmed by a separate test.
The new process is less likely than an instrument fault according to measured probabilities.

exp.trans: 现有模型都解释不了这些读数。它们或许指向一个新过程，但仪器故障仍是另一种解释。有依据的是两种解释仍可并存，新的过程只是可能性之一。
exp.structure: No existing model + explains + the readings。They指readings；could point to是谓语。although从句中a faulty instrument是主语，remains是系动词，another explanation是表语。
exp.other: reading 仪器读数；process 过程；faulty 出故障的；rule out 排除。
exp.meaning: conceivably没有把一种可设想的解释升级为发现。another explanation尤其限制了唯一性；也没有给两种解释排名。
exp.rest: establish ... rule out将可能性改成证实和排除；confirmed by a separate test虚构检验；less likely ... measured probabilities补出概率比较，原文没有量化数据。

scope-role-match.target: 并列信息 / 主语对象
scope-role-match.skill: 正确选项可对应并列句一侧
scope-role-match.q: A critic writes: “The study gives a detailed history of the device but offers little investigation of the failures reported in cold weather.” Two sentences later: “The device’s clearest flaw is that its battery loses capacity after repeated freezing.” What does the study fail to do?
o: provide any historical background
investigate the cold-weather failures sufficiently
prevent the battery from losing capacity
make the device work indefinitely in freezing conditions

exp.trans: 评论者说研究对设备历史讲得很详细，但对寒冷天气中的故障调查不足。后面说设备本身最明显的缺陷是反复结冰后电池容量下降。题目问study，因此答案是调查不足。
exp.structure: but连接两个对study的评价：history详细，failure investigation不足；后句The device’s clearest flaw把主语切到device。
exp.other: capacity 容量；freezing 冰冻环境；investigation 调查；critic 评论者。
exp.meaning: 并列句里一半信息就可以被题目抽出来做同义替换。不要因为答案没同时复述history和failure两侧就排除。
exp.rest: “provide any historical background”与detailed history相反；要求study去prevent battery loss或让device indefinitely work in freezing conditions，都是把研究报告与设备本身的职责混在一起。

point.q: The committee spent twenty minutes arguing about the font on the warning sign, while the real issue was whether the bridge was safe. They were clearly ___.
o: missing the point
making a point
reaching the point
pointing out

diag.1: make a point 常表示“提出观点/特意强调”，这里强调的是没抓住真正问题。
diag.2: reach the point 需要具体语境，如 reach the point where...，不能表达“没抓住重点”。
diag.3: point out 通常后接宾语，表示“指出”；这里既不合结构也不合语义。

exp.trans: 委员会花了二十分钟争论警示牌的字体，而真正的问题是这座桥是否安全。他们显然没有抓住重点。
exp.structure: 第一句：The committee（主语）+ spent（谓语）+ twenty minutes（宾语）；arguing...说明时间花在何事上。while连接对比；whether the bridge was safe作表语从句。第二句：They（主语）+ were missing（现在进行时谓语）+ the point（宾语）。
exp.other: committee 委员会；warning sign 警示牌；issue 问题/争议点；safe 安全的。
exp.meaning: miss the point = 没抓住重点、没理解关键。point 在这里是“要点/关键”，不是“节点”。
exp.rest: make a point = 提出/强调观点；reach the point = 达到某个阶段/程度；point out = 指出某事。只有 missing the point（没抓住重点）符合他们纠结字体却忽视桥梁安全的语境。

point.q:
Even after I explained the joke twice, my brother still missed the point.
missed the point 在这里表示什么？
o: 仍然怀念以前的笑话
仍然没明白笑话的关键
忘记了一个标点符号
没赶上兄弟聚会

exp.trans: 即使我把这个笑话解释了两遍，我弟弟仍然没有明白其中的关键。
exp.structure: 主句：my brother（主语）+ missed（谓语）+ the point（宾语）。after从句：I + explained + the joke；twice修饰explained。even强调即便已经解释过，结果仍如此。
exp.other: joke 笑话；twice 两次；still 仍然；explain 解释。
exp.meaning: miss the point整体表示没领会关键、没明白意思，不能把miss机械地译成怀念。
exp.rest: miss sb可表示想念某人，但miss the point不是这一义项。标点符号一般是punctuation mark，不是这里的point。miss a meeting可表示错过聚会，但原句没有meeting；brother是主语，不是被错过的活动。

point.target: point / there is no point in doing
point.q:
With the last bus already gone, there was no point in waiting at the stop.
point 在这里最接近：
o: 联合会
尖端
分数
意义、用处

exp.trans: 末班车已经开走了，继续在车站等也没有意义。
exp.structure: 主干：there was no point in waiting at the stop，是there be存在句。With the last bus already gone补充原因背景。简单句The last bus was already gone → 去掉was，用with + 名词 + 状态补语压缩。
exp.other: last bus 末班车；already 已经；be gone 已经离开、不在了；bus stop 公交站。
exp.meaning: there is no point in doing sth：做某事没有意义；point不是物理位置上的点。
exp.rest: 联合会常用federation/association，与句意无关。尖端可用the point of a needle，必须是具体物体的尖端。分数可说score three points，但这里不是计分语境。

subject.target: subject A to B / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q:
The cleaner deliberately subjected the curtains to a steam treatment yesterday.
要保留“昨天实际施加了处理”的含义，哪句被动改写准确？
o: The curtains are subject to changes in fashion.
The curtains were exempt from treatment yesterday.
The curtains were subjected to a steam treatment by the cleaner yesterday.
The curtains are suitable for steam treatment.

exp.trans: 清洁人员昨天特意对窗帘做了蒸汽处理。被动句：窗帘昨天被清洁人员进行了蒸汽处理。
exp.structure: 主动简单句：The cleaner（主语）+ subjected（谓语）+ the curtains（宾语）+ to a steam treatment。→ 把宾语the curtains提升为被动句主语，把subjected改成were subjected，并用by保留施事：The curtains were subjected to a steam treatment by the cleaner yesterday。
exp.other: cleaner 清洁人员；curtain 窗帘；deliberately 特意地；steam treatment 蒸汽处理。
exp.meaning: subject A to B表示使A经历B；变成被动结构就是A be subjected to B，实际处理过程仍然保留。
exp.rest: are subject to changes in fashion：说窗帘可能受时尚变化影响，不是昨天被处理的事件。were exempt from treatment：免于处理，与原文相反。are suitable for steam treatment：适合做处理，只表示适宜性，不能证明处理发生过。

subject.target: be subject to / 实际事件
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: The mountain road is subject to closure during heavy snow. No closure has been announced today. Which report preserves both statements?
o: The road has already been closed after a snowstorm.
Heavy snow can lead to closure, but these lines do not report a closure today.
The road has been subjected to a closure test today.
The road is open because heavy snow cannot affect its status.

exp.trans: 这条山路在大雪期间可能封闭。今天尚未宣布封路。准确报道是：大雪可能带来封路，但这两句没有报道今天已经封路。
exp.structure: The mountain road是主语，is是系动词，subject to closure表达所受约束或可能状态。第二句No closure是主语，has been announced是现在完成时被动谓语；没有公告不等于已验证现场一定开放。
exp.other: mountain road 山路；closure 封闭；announce 宣布；status 状态。
exp.meaning: be subject to可表示有可能受某变化影响，不自动表示该事件已经发生。这里也不能从“尚无公告”推出现场已确认开放。
exp.rest: already been closed把可能状态改成已发生事件；subjected to a closure test虚构今天被施加测试的过程；open because ... cannot affect同时虚构开放状态并否认原文给出的封闭风险。

take-page-from.skill: 固定表达 / 借鉴做法
take-page-from.q: To reduce missed appointments, the clinic decided to take a page from airlines and send automatic reminders before each visit. What does take a page from airlines mean here?
o: 雇用航空公司的员工来管理诊所
借鉴航空公司的做法
把预约记录交给航空公司保存
要求病人乘飞机前来就诊

exp.trans: 为了减少爽约，诊所决定借鉴航空公司的做法，在每次就诊前发送自动提醒。
exp.structure: The clinic是主语，decided是谓语，to take a page from airlines与send automatic reminders共同说明采取的措施。from airlines标出借鉴对象，不表示人员招聘。
exp.other: missed appointment 爽约；clinic 诊所；automatic reminder 自动提醒；visit 就诊。
exp.meaning: take a page from sb./sth. = 借鉴某人或某机构的做法、经验。不是recruit或hire。
exp.rest: 雇人需要hire/recruit；交记录和乘飞机都没有文本依据，且无法解释后面的自动提醒。
